$comment: ACC v2 — the agentd v1.3.1 store-over-MCP contract (the 'checkpointer profile', crates/agentd/src/store/mcp.rs default_ops). agentd's store.kind: mcp maps its four store operations onto tools/call against a declared server; a server advertising these four tools needs zero mapping config. agentctl's state service (RFC 0031 §2) MUST implement exactly this. All four remappable via store.mcp.{put,get,list,delete} = {tool, args, ok, conflict, value, keys}.
key_layout: <store.prefix>/<instance>/<kind>/<id> — instance = agent.name; every write is a seq CAS; a Conflict on an owned key is fatal split-brain for the agent (preserve the fence, never paper over it)

meta.agent/idempotency_key: "<key>#<seq>" on every call — replays of the same put MUST be idempotent

result.conflict: result.structuredContent.latest — non-null (the latest seq as u64) ⇒ CAS conflict
result.error: isError:true with neither ⇒ transport/server error (agentd retries per store policy)

state.put.semantics: compare-and-set: accept iff the stored seq for key is exactly seq-1 (insert when seq==1 and absent); on mismatch return latest, never overwrite

result.absent: a tool-domain error (isError:true) on a read means ABSENT, not failure

result.keys: result.structuredContent.keys — array of "key" strings or {key, seq?} objects

advertisement: agentd narrows to the ops the server actually advertises after tools/list: a missing state.list/state.delete degrades those ops to Unsupported; put/get are required
latency_budget: store I/O is synchronous on agentd's reactor thread — the service's in-cluster p99 target is ≤50 ms (RFC 0031 §2); slow state = slow agent (timers, drains, liveness all stall)
tenancy_rule: the serving implementation derives the permissible key prefix from the VERIFIED caller identity, never from arguments — an agent must be unable to name another agent's keys
